goal: Make the eligibility results_ready gate read as a pending human-review step (not 'done') and give the card an obvious path forward to approve.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The badge for a results_ready run does not contain the word 'listos' and is textually distinct from the terminal 'Listo' state
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: Playwright: execute a country run, assert card badge text matches /Pendiente de revisión/i and NOT /Resultados listos/i

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The card shows a clickable 'Revisar y aprobar' button that opens the detail modal containing the 'Aprobar y Aplicar' action
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: Playwright: in results_ready, click 'Revisar y aprobar' on the card, assert dialog opens and contains button /Aprobar y Aplicar/i

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Approving from that path advances the run past 2/8 to completion (mock auto-advances)
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: Playwright: full lifecycle execute -> Revisar y aprobar -> Aprobar -> upload -> finalize -> badge 'Listo'

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Unit + lint + typecheck pass and eligibility e2e is green
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: npm test && npm run lint && npx tsc -b && playwright test e2e/eligibility.spec.ts

tasks.desc: Reword results_ready badge label in types.ts STATUS_CONFIG to 'Pendiente de revisión' (also mordom_ready -> 'Revisar MorDom')
Replace inert 'Revisar resultados' text in EligibilityCountryCard with a clickable 'Revisar y aprobar' button that opens the detail modal; suppress redundant 'Ver detalle' in results_ready
Update existing eligibility e2e (badge text) and add coverage for the new button + clarity
